en.research_intro: Connecting visual recognition with spatial information, from individual structures to entire cities.

research.title: Multi-view RGB-D defect measurement
research.subtitle: Multi-view RGB-D perception · Supervisor: Dr. Rongpan Hu
research.q: Detections of the same defect across views do not directly yield consistent physical dimensions. Multiple observations need a shared metric reference.
research.method: Developed a target-level pipeline combining semantic segmentation, marker-based pose estimation, cross-view association and quality-gated fusion in a shared metric reference frame.
research.result: Six crack targets: length MAE 2.17 mm and mean-width MAE 0.22 mm. Two spalling targets: area MARE 2.90% and mean-depth MARE 3.21%. Manuscript in preparation.
research.next: Research question I want to pursue: how should a sensing system choose the next view to reduce measurement uncertainty?

research.title: Tunnel conduit detection and localisation
research.subtitle: Advanced support conduit detection · Advisor: Prof. Min Chen
research.q: Manual inspection provides limited quantitative records of conduit positions and spacing in tunnel advance support.
research.method: Led construction of a dataset with 6,000+ field images and trained YOLO detectors. Integrated stereo-camera calibration and SGBM depth estimation to connect detections with 3D conduit locations; explored pruning and ONNX deployment.
research.result: Preliminary AP@0.5 ≈ 0.80, with an integrated detection and stereo-depth localisation prototype.
research.next: What this led me to ask: how can visual recognition become reliable geometric measurement?

research.title: Beauty and distinctiveness in Hong Kong street views
research.subtitle: Hong Kong street-view analysis · Advisor: Prof. Xiao Li
research.q: Average aesthetic scores can conceal disagreement. The aim is to identify Hong Kong scenes that combine perceived beauty with visual distinctiveness.
research.method: Implemented a seven-encoder voting ensemble, 5,000-replicate bootstrap analysis and multi-layer kNN distinctiveness scoring, with spatial aggregation and GIS exports.
research.result: Inference across 56,530 Hong Kong panoramas (226,120 directional views), yielding 435 view-level candidates for subsequent spatial analysis.
research.next: Research question I want to pursue: how can spatial context and disagreement improve interpretation of visual predictions?

other.title: Medical-image analysis across datasets

other.q: Address variation across oral-image datasets and connect image assessment with longitudinal follow-up.
other.method: Led computational implementation for model evaluation and a research platform integrating assessment and follow-up.
other.result: Test Macro-F1: 0.921 internally (n=665), 0.885 on OMD (n=173), and 0.937 on OralTriD (n=80). Manuscript in preparation.

en.build_intro: Two public projects show how I turn spatial methods into usable applications and research workflows.
en.film_q: How can a static list of film locations become a city route people can explore?
en.film_method: Organised film and scene data with Python, built a Room/SQLite database, and implemented map browsing, scene check-ins and half-day route planning in Android.
en.film_result: 68 films · 97 places · 142 scene records (85 with usable coordinates).
en.skill_q: How can an AI-assisted geospatial workflow remain reviewable and reproducible?
en.skill_method: Connected source-grounded analysis planning, GEE script generation, validation, execution checks and run records in a reusable workflow.
en.skill_result: Includes NDVI examples, a Python CLI and an HLS/MODIS product-consistency report.
en.skill_caption: Plan → evidence → validation → controlled execution → trace.

future.title: Useful cross-modal knowledge transfer
future.text: Where does depth improve segmentation, and how can an RGB model retain that useful information? I plan to study depth-assisted training with RGB-only deployment.

future.title: Reliable perception across scenes
future.text: Which representations remain useful when scenes, scales or sensor conditions change? Cross-scene transfer or data-efficient fine-structure learning would be a focused next step.

future.title: Active observation & autonomous understanding
future.text: Where should a system look next, from which viewpoint, and when has it observed enough? This is my intended connection to autonomous mapping and embodied intelligence.

research.title: 多视角 RGB-D 缺陷量测
research.meta: 2025—至今 · 研究助理 · 香港理工大学
research.subtitle: 多视角 RGB-D 感知 · 导师：Dr. Rongpan Hu
research.q: 同一缺陷在不同视角下的检测并不直接对应一致的物理尺寸，需要将多次观测放进统一度量参考系。
research.method: 开发目标级 RGB-D 流程，将语义分割、标记物位姿估计、跨视角目标关联和质量门控融合连接到统一的度量参考系。
research.result: 6 个裂缝目标：长度 MAE 2.17 mm，平均宽度 MAE 0.22 mm；2 个剥落目标：面积 MARE 2.90%，平均深度 MARE 3.21%。论文准备中。
research.tags: RGB-D / 三维视觉 / 基础设施检测
research.next: 希望进一步研究：感知系统如何选择下一观测视角，以降低量测不确定性？
research.metric_label: 多视角 · 几何 · 量测

research.title: 隧道小导管检测与定位
research.meta: 2023—2024 · 大学生科研训练项目负责人 · 西南交通大学
research.subtitle: 超前小导管识别 · 导师：Prof. Min Chen
research.q: 人工检查难以持续记录隧道超前支护小导管的位置与间距，希望将现场图像转化为可量化的检查信息。
research.method: 带领构建 6,000 余幅现场图像数据集并训练 YOLO 检测器，结合双目标定与 SGBM 深度估计，将图像检测连接到三维位置；探索模型剪枝和 ONNX 部署。
research.result: 初步 AP@0.5 ≈ 0.80，完成目标检测与双目深度定位的原型集成。
research.tags: 目标检测 / 双目几何 / 工程原型
research.next: 由此形成的问题：视觉识别如何进一步转化为可靠的几何量测？

research.title: 香港街景美感与独特性
research.meta: 2026—至今 · 硕士研究项目 · GIFT Lab
research.subtitle: 香港街景分析 · 导师：Prof. Xiao Li
research.q: 平均审美分数可能掩盖评价分歧，希望识别兼具美感与视觉独特性的香港街景。
research.method: 实现七编码器投票集成、5,000 次 bootstrap 分析与多层 kNN 独特性评分，并连接空间聚合和 GIS 导出。
research.result: 完成 56,530 幅香港全景图（226,120 个方向视图）的推理，筛选出 435 个视图级候选，进入后续空间分析。
research.tags: 计算机视觉 / 城市感知 / GIS
research.next: 希望进一步研究：空间语境与评价分歧，如何帮助解释视觉模型的预测？

zh.skill_result: 包含 NDVI 示例、Python 命令行工具，以及 HLS/MODIS 产品一致性对比报告。
zh.skill_caption: 计划 → 证据 → 验证 → 受控执行 → 运行记录。
